# The reply to bob's voucher fails to open: bob is still joining, says why, and opens it when he
# tries again a little later, without restarting.

fail-opens 1
create alice g
join bob g
run
invite alice g bob
run
state bob g
----
joined

show bob g
----
— minting a voucher
— give the voucher code to a member of the group (it is also in voucher-g.txt)
— wait for the voucher's reply failed: transport: sim: open failed
— joined the group
